subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: After the lifecycle cleanup fix, should this PR still require real Discord voice proof, or may maintainers explicitly accept dependency-level regression tests as a proof override?
rationale: The branch targets a live Discord voice workflow, but the PR body says no configured two-account live setup is available, so proof sufficiency needs maintainer intent if the contributor cannot provide a real run.

options.title: Require cleanup plus live proof
options.body: Fix the lifecycle cleanup defect, then require redacted logs, terminal output, or a live trace showing account-scoped voice joins or already-ready autoJoin recovery before merge.

options.title: Override proof after cleanup
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the dependency-level tests after the cleanup defect is fixed if a safe live two-account environment is unavailable.

recommendation.title: Require cleanup plus live proof
recommendation.body: Fix the lifecycle cleanup defect, then require redacted logs, terminal output, or a live trace showing account-scoped voice joins or already-ready autoJoin recovery before merge.
